# nemau load-balancer certificate

TLS certificates for TERMINATED_HTTPS listeners.

A certificate is imported into the project, then named by its ID with
"nemau lb listener create --protocol TERMINATED_HTTPS --tls-certificate `<id>`".
The private key is sealed by the platform and never shown again.

A certificate is immutable. To renew one without downtime:

```
nemau lb certificate import --name www-2027 --certificate fullchain.pem --private-key privkey.pem
nemau lb listener update <listener-id> --tls-certificate <new-id>
nemau lb certificate delete <old-id>
```

## Usage

```
nemau load-balancer certificate [command]
```

Aliases: `certificates`, `cert`, `certs`

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [delete](nemau_load-balancer_certificate_delete.md) | Delete a certificate no listener serves |
| [get](nemau_load-balancer_certificate_get.md) | Show one certificate |
| [import](nemau_load-balancer_certificate_import.md) | Import a certificate and its private key from PEM files |
| [list](nemau_load-balancer_certificate_list.md) | List the project's certificates |

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
